title: 2026-08-29 — architecture panel
text:
22 agents (2 ground readers, 4 biased proposals, 3 judges, synthesis, 12 refuters).
Shape that survived: keep Flask/Celery/Postgres/Redis; a diagram becomes a JSON
document + append-only command log; ONE Python module mutates; browser and agent are
both clients of one endpoint; agent loop in a worker streaming via Redis→SSE; front
end = one Vite/TypeScript SVG page served by Flask, installed as a PWA; release
collapses to tag → one image → compose pull. 9–13 focused weeks to phone+desktop
parity; first headless milestone ~2 weeks.

Refuters killed the synthesis's numbers, not its shape — corrections are binding:
- Full-document-per-update is out: 500 people/5k events ≈ 1.6–3 MB JSON. Server sends
  patches; client keeps a small reducer for optimistic drags (else 300–800 ms drag lag).
- The layout engine cannot hold pinned people (Pro's "arrange selection" is a filter,
  not a constraint). Constrained placement is real new work (~1–2 wk) — the same item
  deferred since May.

  cached across turns: realistic input $0.20–0.50/turn Opus-class; viable Sonnet-class.
  Consequence: compact neighborhood read

title: 2026-09-07: Clusters are stored server-side; a stretch the user named is not regrouped away
text:
**Context:** The ruling is that clusters are stored, not derived on read, but nothing wrote them: the
page grouped events by the silences between them and the coach could not point at the result, so a
chip aimed at a stretch never resolved. Detection existed only behind a stateless endpoint the client
called by hand.

**Decision:** A coach turn that changes an event re-groups the line server-side and writes the result
into the record through the one write path, authored by the coach in the same turn, so the grouping
carries a change log and an undo like every other item. A cache key on the record keeps the model call
off turns that change nothing the grouping depends on; it is compared in the writer only, never on
read. A grouping keeps its id across re-detection, matched by event overlap,

text: Show tool: anything deterministic is a tool call with parameters; the show tool takes record ids plus a closed set of view kinds (start: triangle over three people, span over a time range, compare two moments, sequence of moves); every parameter must resolve to stored data or the call fails; fidelity to what the user said is enforced by tool design, never left to the model; each added view kind must show something meaningful; start simple, extend per view

text: Change log: a new SQLAlchemy model Change beside Discussion/Statement — one row per command (tool call, Pro save, manual edit) with a jsonb deltas list of {item_id, item_kind, field, before, after}, turn_id macro grouping (one coach reply / one save), write-time compression of consecutive deltas on the same item+field (first before, last after), user_id/session_id, server applies commands in arrival order one at a time per diagram, undo per user per turn via inverse deltas with compare-and-set on before. title: Ground truth is reached in three stages: (1) each coder codes the case from scratch, blind; (2) once everyone,
text: Ground truth is reached in three stages: (1) each coder codes the case from scratch, blind; (2) once everyone, or a checkpoint's worth of coders, has finished, each votes before the meeting on every outstanding disagreement; (3) the IRR meeting reviews the vote results with a thin chance for final corrections, then ratifies. At each stage a voter must make a decision that results in a finalized record; agreement converges progressively. Supersedes the no-pre-review clause of R-0244; its prototype-in-meetings clause stands

title: Nobody is paid: no quota of chatting or coding between meetings; the work is a rolling window. Many sessions w
text: Nobody is paid: no quota of chatting or coding between meetings; the work is a rolling window. Many sessions will be left unfinished and coding keeps going on the same session even as people add more to it; but human-only ground truth is finite, so convergence is required. Whether to force convergence is undecided; the cost of not forcing it is never converging, which is what happened last year, when most of the time went to teaching a tool too complicated for non-technical therapists. Settling a whole kind of disagreement with one rule is one tool among a few to keep

title: 2026-09-12: FD-362 Pro surfaces — one licence gate, no second app
text:
**Context:** Building the Pro screens drawn in `doc/chat-first/mockups/pro.html` (frames f1–f7):
cases, uploading a recording, notes, and the drawer pinned open on a wide window.

**Decisions accepted:**
- **One gate, read from the licence, not the role.** `personal/licence.py:professional()` is true

  bootstrap and on the account payload, and the front end reads it once (`web/src/pro.ts`). Every
  Pro-only route refuses as 404, never 403: a reader without the licence is never told the surface
  exists (R-0237, R-0285).

id: D:2026-09-12: Tool schemas say the shape, fdserver says the me

text:
**Decision**: the clinical wording on the record-writing tools' parameters (variables,
event kinds, relationship moves, the child-focus case) lives in fdserver's private prompt

read the same schemas. Under R-0305.
**Rejected**: leaving the text on the tools in btcopilot (public repo; it is the IP);
duplicating a second schema for the scribe.
**Open**: the scribe's own prompt (ruled behaviours of the coding loop, never in fdserver)
stays in btcopilot pending Patrick's word.

title: 2026-09-12: Billing and old users for the chat-first product (Patrick's word: "sounds good")
text:

customer portal, subscription state mirrored into the users table by webhook that re-fetches

as active, whether or not that point carries anything itself. So the tier ranking is a
period ranking.

Counting the points that actually carry a nodal flag or a non-"none" variable

substantially against the active tiers — the case ranked second by active period

variable value, while the case ranked fifth by period carries the second-densest
variable tagging in the corpus. Two cases sitting in the top tier by period carry

title: Notability thread ruled: .fd files are the single source of truth
text:
Patrick redirected the pipeline design and it got simpler. The app already stores a
unique random alias per person and substitutes name+nickname with the alias in all
event/person notes text behind the hide-names toggle (verified in the scene code).
Ruling: handwritten PDFs are interpreted ONCE by a BAA provider and their content is
entered INTO the .fd diagram files (mostly merging timeline events into diagrams
that already carry the structure); he reviews by opening diagrams with aliases on;
a translator (extension of rebuild.py) then emits the anonymous corpus from any
diagram — today's allowlist PLUS alias-scrubbed text and parent-child links (which
also removes the STRUCTURE-session whitelist blocker). No ledger, no second schema.

known gap (surnames alone, places, misspelled handwritten names pass through) is a
mechanical name-list scan with quarantine for his eyeball. Open approvals: that
